channel.title: Rodolfo Vasco: articles
channel.description: Articles by Rodolfo Vasco on artificial intelligence, martech, performance, analytics and SEO, AEO and GEO, drawing on 17 years in the market.

item.title: Performance Media in the AI Era: What Changes and What to Do
item.description: Ad platforms now automate bids, audiences and formats with AI. What is left for the media professional is what the machine can't solve alone: quality data, creative, a conversion strategy and measurement of real results.

item.title: AI labels in ads: what they are and what to do
item.description: Ads with AI-created or AI-edited assets can receive labels on ad platforms. In Google Ads the advertiser declares AI use and the platform may also label on its own. It pays to build an internal process to know what was AI-generated, declare it correctly and keep a record.

item.title: Data Analytics: What It Is, 4 Types and Where to Start
item.description: Data analytics is the process of collecting, organizing and analyzing data to make better decisions. There are four types of analysis (descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive), and the path starts with a business question, not a tool.

item.title: SEO, AEO and GEO: the difference and where to start
item.description: SEO gets your page to show up in search. AEO gets your content chosen as the direct answer. GEO gets generative AI to cite your brand. All three start from the same base, a fast, crawlable site with clear answers. Start there.
